text: Thanh Hoa targets 21.5 million tourist arrivals by 2030

Central Thanh Hoa Province aims to welcome approximately 21.5 million visitors, including 1.6 million international arrivals, by 2030, with tourism revenue projected to reach VND94.2 trillion ($3.57 billion), according to its tourism development plan through 2030, with a vision to 2035.
By 2035, the province expects to attract more than 27 million visitors and generate over VND170 trillion in tourism revenue.
The tourism development plan was reviewed at a meeting of the provincial authorities on November 18.
In 2025, Thanh Hoa welcomed approximately 16.28 million visitors, including more than 852,000 international tourists, generating an estimated VND45.6 trillion in revenue.
Tourist arrivals increased 6.1% from 2024, while revenue surged 34.8%.
During the first 10 months, the province received an estimated 16.24 million visitors, equivalent to 96.7% of its annual target.
Tourism revenue reached approximately VND45.2 trillion, fulfilling 91.4% of the yearly goal.
To sustain growth, Thanh Hoa plans to shift its focus from expanding tourism numbers to improving quality and adding value.
Priorities include developing distinctive tourism products that can attract visitors year-round, reducing dependence on peak seasons and established destinations.

The province also aims to strengthen connections between destinations, improve tourism management and accelerate digital transformation to enhance promotion, information services and visitor experiences.

Tourism development will go hand in hand with heritage conservation and environmental protection, ensuring that cultural values, landscapes and ecological resources are preserved to maintain the province's long-term appeal.
